profile.title: Complete your profile
profile.body: Set a handle, a short bio or your birthday so friends can find you and know what to give you.
profile.here: Fill in at least one: handle, bio or birthday.

wishlist.title: Create your first wishlist
wishlist.body: Make a wishlist for a birthday, wedding, new baby or any moment worth celebrating.
wishlist.here: Give it a name (e.g. "My 30th birthday") and pick a cover. Visibility defaults to friends only; dates and rules can be changed later. Then tap "Create and add items" at the bottom.

item.title: Add the things you want
item.body: Your list is ready. Now add the things you'd love to receive.
item.here: Tap "+ Add item". Paste a product link to fill in the name and image automatically, then set the quantity and notes.

publish.title: Publish and become a recipient
publish.body: Drafts are only visible to you. Publish the list to share its link with family and friends.
publish.here: When your items look good, tap "Publish and share" and paste the link into LINE or a group chat. You'll be notified when friends claim gifts, so nobody gives the same thing twice.

give.title: Give a gift and become a giver
give.body: Now try the other side: pick an item on someone else's list and claim it.
give.here: Open someone else's list and tap "I'll give this" on an item. After claiming, buy it and come back to mark it, so they know it's on the way.

done.title: You're all set!
done.body: You know how to make a wish and how to give one. You can restart the tour any time in Settings.

welcome.lead: Wishly turns the gifts you want into a list you share by link. When friends claim a gift, the list updates instantly, so no one doubles up. Follow these 5 steps to go from making a wish to giving one.
welcome.roleReceiverBody: Create and publish a wishlist so people know what you'd like.
welcome.roleGiverBody: Claim a gift on someone else's list and give exactly what they want.
welcome.nameHint: This is the name your friends will see.
welcome.profileHint: Fill in at least one of handle, bio or birthday. You can change them later in Settings.
welcome.profileNeedOne: Please fill in at least one of handle, bio or birthday
welcome.closedBody: You've finished or skipped the getting-started tour. You can restart it to go through it again.

settings.title: Getting started tour
settings.hint: Walk through it again: profile → create a list → add items → publish → give.
